subject: afi
title: AFI.------EXP.INFO.B.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 500 (TRF(II)-36). AFI (affinity insight) is the subject; EXP-INFO-B (expansion information basis) is the partner. From the subject: TM (terminology—or terms of a definition), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", TR (transformation) and SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). From TM: CULT-AF-B (culture affinity basis). From TR: OP-SD (option spread). From SPT-DY: IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment). From CULT-AF-B: POST (postulation). From OP-SD: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From IST-S-ALGN: MT-INFO (multi-information).
